rule.text: Figures are rounded with the largest-remainder method so each row adds up exactly. A specialist is a category whose share is at least 1.5× or at most 0.67× Canada's share (categories under 1% both here and nationally are skipped); up to 4 over- and 2 under-represented are listed. Small cells Statistics Canada suppresses for confidentiality count as 0; a row is left out when they could add up to more than 3% of its published total. The census week, in May 2021, fell during COVID-19 restrictions, so many more people worked from home than usual. Commute shares are of workers, not of all residents.
